# Tony Joy

> The patch cable between artists and machines. Tony Joy introduces and weaves new tools into the workflows of professionals who make films, music and games, then takes their feedback to the product and engineering teams who build the tools. Based in Los Angeles.

- Sound Particles (2022 to 2026): VP, Business Development and Creative Services. Global link between engineering, product and the professionals who use its tools; built partnerships with global technology companies and leading resellers; helped shape Sound Particles 3, Beat Panner and a legally cleared B2B audio dataset for AI developers.
- Avid (2018 to 2022): Pro Audio Solutions Specialist. Built and ran Avid's first Immersive Audio Lab in Los Angeles.
- A.R. Rahman: technology advisor since 2007; ran his Los Angeles studio for eight years, engineering songs and scoring sessions for Hollywood and Bollywood films.
- Live: designed and deployed A.R. Rahman's performance rig at TED 2016; front of house for Vidya Vox's live shows, 2017 to 2019.
- 25+ film credits on IMDb, 250+ songs, 750+ radio commercials, 1,000+ ringtones.
- Sports Emmy nominee, 2019 (shared): Outstanding Music Composition/Direction/Lyrics, Momentum Generation.
- Residency: Google Flow Music Sessions, Cohort 2 (2026).
- Recording Academy voting member; Audio Engineering Society; Motion Picture Sound Editors (affiliate). MA, Post-Production Sound Design, Bournemouth University.
